title: A tracked pull request
description: Replaces the hand-parsed tracking files under ~/.fyi/work/prs. The watcher owns lifecycle and attention; reviewers own the review sections.

number.description: Derived from url; leave it out.

repo.description: Owner/Repo. Derived from url; leave it out.

url.description: Link to the pull request, e.g. https://github.com/Owner/Repo/pull/123. Identifies it: the id, repo and number are derived from it, and a PR already tracked cannot be captured twice.

triage_reason.description: Why this matters, naming the interest rules that matched.

auto_reviewed_commit.description: Short SHA last reviewed automatically. A different HEAD means a re-review is due.

findings.description: required/optional counts, e.g. 2/1. Required means it blocks merge.

followups.description: The author's choice for each optional finding, by id.

issue.description: URL of the follow-up issue, once filed.

complexity.description: How much reading a review takes. Estimated at triage from the diff size; the reviewer corrects it.

draft_review.description: A review written but not posted: the full markdown comment. The user posts it with their verdict via /j:pr-checkout; cleared once posted.

attention.description: Whether the user needs to look at this now. Derived from the attention items.

type.description: What the user must do. 'assign' now means the automatic assignment failed, not that a triage decision is pending. 'decide' is a design question only a maintainer can settle.

who.description: Whose move it is: the user; the PR's author; another maintainer; or a session (a review or CI investigation not done yet). Only 'user' entries are why the user is needed.

attention_items.description: What has to happen on this PR, one entry each, naming whose move it is. Several sessions write here: change entries with add/remove on fyi_update rather than setting the whole list, or entries others wrote are lost.

summary.description: What the PR does and what the user needs to decide. Written even when no review comment is posted.

synced_at.description: When this was last confirmed against GitHub, as opposed to last changed. Set by passing synced:true to fyi_update.
